question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3 i.e. 'increasingly'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**increasingly**" indicates **a growing trend or condition**, fitting the context of expanding challenges faced by brands in engaging consumers.
 
• It accurately reflects the escalation of the difficulty in capturing the dwindling attention spans of consumers.
 
• The adverb "**increasingly**" signifies the gradual intensification of the situation described in the passage, emphasizing the progressive nature of the challenge.

**Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options **("increase", "increasing", "increased") **do not grammatically fit the context of describing how an action is happening over time, thus "increasingly" is chosen for its adverbial form that modifies the act of finding it challenging.

**Complete Passage is: Today**, there are numerous products available for customers to select from, whether they are using a physical store or **an **online shopping platform. Almost every product or brand has **its **own USP, packaging, colour combinations and more as marketing tactics, which it uses to market itself to the customers in a **unique **manner. Brands find it **increasingly **challenging to engage consumers as their attention spans are dwindling at an accelerated rate
